crucialFeats: Picks up and slams down a Y-Wing bomber.
Slams two starships together with telekinesis.
Impales himself to kill the reborn Darth Maul.
Blocks an energy blast with his hand.
Survives a giant explosion that destroys a casino.

dossier.advantage: Elite precision and an iron defense. His mastery of the Force allows him to control the environment and the enemy's body, preventing effective counterattacks.
dossier.mentality: Cold, patient, and ruthless. He waits for the smallest mistake from the opponent to end the fight with a single, vengeful strike.
dossier.quote: All I am surrounded by is fear. And dead men.
dossier.style: Technical pressure fighting with the Force. He combines perfect lightsaber swordsmanship with brutal telekinesis to choke and crush opponents in close quarters.

fighterA.name: Darth Vader

powers: Force telekinesis, precognition, choke and crush techniques, and elite lightsaber lethality.
tools: Defensive saber discipline, blaster and energy deflection, and Force-based battlefield control.
weaknesses: Cybernetic life-support dependence and vulnerability to sustained system disruption.
Lower raw physical durability and scale than top cosmic entities.

crucialFeats: Destroys a planet during a fight with Drax.
Walks out of a gas-giant explosion unharmed.

dossier.advantage: Near-absolute invulnerability and tactical genius. He possesses a body capable of surviving attacks from gods and a mind that instantly turns an enemy's mistake into their inevitable defeat.
dossier.mentality: Arrogant nihilist with iron discipline. He fights with absolute certainty of his superiority, seeking to ruthlessly crush anyone who stands in his way.
dossier.quote: I did not force you to fight me. You forced me into doing what I did. I had to be faithful to my nature. For, after all, I am Thanos.
dossier.style: Brutal, precise powerhouse combat. Thanos combines mastery of hand-to-hand combat with devastating cosmic energy blasts to systematically crush any defense.

fighterB.name: Thanos

powers: Massive strength and durability, cosmic energy projection, force fields, and matter manipulation.
tools: Strategic intellect, combat adaptability, and broad resistance profile.
weaknesses: Arrogance and tendency to test opponents can create early openings.
Without Infinity Stones, he remains elite but lacks Gauntlet-level instant authority.

victories: Beta Ray Bill and Ronan the Accuser

battle-dynamics.analysis: Vader can control moments. Thanos controls what the fight becomes.
battle-dynamics.phase_1: Vader starts higher because his control and timing make the first exchange dangerous.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Thanos grows stronger as soon as the first bypass fails and the fight turns physical.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Vader's line collapses once he has to absorb cosmic-level punishment repeatedly.

fight-simulation.end_condition: If the first bypass fails, the fight becomes Thanos's immediately.
fight-simulation.late_fight: The fight becomes shields, beams, brute-force counters, and body punishment that Vader cannot absorb repeatedly.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Thanos survives the first surgical attempt and stops treating the exchange like a technical duel.
fight-simulation.opening: Vader opens with telekinesis, precognition, and close-range lethality.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Vader tries to keep the fight technical with more Force pressure and angles.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Thanos turns the map into shields, beams, and direct body punishment.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Thanos survives the first real solve attempt and stops respecting the duel.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: A miracle bypass would have to end the fight immediately.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: Thanos absorbs, counters, and ends the fight by force.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Vader can still threaten moments, but the exchange no longer belongs to him.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Vader opens with telekinesis, precognition, and close-range lethality.

final-summary.line_1: Vader wins precision categories, but Thanos wins the categories that actually decide the finish.
final-summary.line_2: Vader's opening remains dangerous, yet the durability and scale gap are too large to solve consistently.
final-summary.line_3: This is a stable matchup, not a branch-heavy one.

interpretation.line_1: On paper Thanos wins because he owns the categories that decide whether Vader can finish at all.
interpretation.line_2: Vader still has a dangerous first minute because his technical opening is much cleaner than Thanos's.
interpretation.line_3: The opening is real, but the overall fight stays Thanos's once he survives the first surgical attempt.
interpretation.quote: Better technique is not enough if it never becomes a finish route.

stat-trap.example: Vader can win the first read and still lose the fight because the target is built to survive that read.
stat-trap.question: Can Vader create a lethal bypass before Thanos learns he does not need to respect the duel?

tactical-board.lane: Vader must solve the fight fast. Thanos only needs the opening to fail once.
tactical-board.subtitle: Sith Lord versus Titan

x-factor.implication: If Thanos survives the first real bypass, the fight immediately shifts onto his terms.
x-factor.mechanics: Vader can only win if the first surgical attempt truly bypasses Thanos's cosmic durability.
x-factor.psychology: Vader wants a controlled duel. Thanos wants the fight to become a long execution.
